preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The input string s must be in lowercase.
The input string s must contain only alphabetic characters.
The input string s must not be empty.

postconditions.description: The output must be a string.
The output string must have the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: all((c in 'aeiou' and (ord(c) - 5 - ord('a')) % 26 + ord('a') not in 'code') or (c not in 'aeiou' and (ord(c) + 9 - ord('a')) % 26 + ord('a') not in 'code') for c in s)
postconditions.description: If a character is a vowel, it must be moved back 5 places unless it becomes 'c', 'o', 'd', or 'e'. If a character is a consonant, it must be moved forward 9 places unless it becomes 'c', 'o', 'd', or 'e'.

postconditions.expression: all((c in 'aeiou' and (ord(c) - 5 - ord('a')) % 26 + ord('a') == ord(return_value[i]) or (c not in 'aeiou' and (ord(c) + 9 - ord('a')) % 26 + ord('a') == ord(return_value[i]))) for i, c in enumerate(s) if c not in 'code')
postconditions.description: Each character in the output string must be the result of moving the corresponding character in the input string according to the rules, unless the character is 'c', 'o', 'd', or 'e'.

postconditions.expression: all((c in 'code' and ord(c) == ord(return_value[i])) for i, c in enumerate(s) if c in 'code')
postconditions.description: If a character in the input string is 'c', 'o', 'd', or 'e', it must remain unchanged in the output string.
